inj.note: The Jaguars have yet to confirm the report, but the left tackle can be safely ruled out for Sunday's game against the Texans in London and could be at risk of missing additional time following the team's Week 7 bye. After Harrison was unable to check back into this past Sunday's win over the Eagles, Walker Little stepped in as his replacement at left tackle. Little could be headed for a start in Week 6 if the Jaguars opt to keep starting right tackle Cole Van Lanen at his current position.

news.h: Sources: Jaguars LT Anton Harrison to undergo knee surgery
news.d: Jaguars left tackle Anton Harrison will have arthroscopic surgery on his right knee when the team returns from London next week, league sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.
